notes: Three co-transmitters first, then Zuhayr's own restatement («قال زهير حدثنا سفيان بن عيينة») that names Sufyan in full: a second group with the same first man, written again. The text then gives al-Zuhri, al-A'raj and Abu Hurayra once: the shared tail.
«سمعت أبا هريرة» makes Abu Hurayra the last link; his own words follow.
